items_flat.title_en: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos Preview Finds Novel Cryptographic Attacks on HAWK and Reduced AES
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic Claude Mythos Preview 發現 HAWK 與簡化 AES 的新密碼攻擊
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that Claude Mythos Preview autonomously discovered an improved key-recovery attack on the post-quantum signature scheme HAWK (halving effective strength, e.g. HAWK-256 from 2^64 to 2^38) and a Möbius Bridge technique that speeds reduced-round AES attacks by 200-800×. These advances do not affect production systems.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team 報告，Claude Mythos Preview 自主發現後量子簽名方案 HAWK 的改進密鑰恢復攻擊（有效強度減半，HAWK-256 從 2^64 降至 2^38），以及 Möbius Bridge 技術使簡化輪數 AES 攻擊加速 200-800 倍。這些發現目前不影響生產系統。
items_flat.analysis_en: The results show frontier models can deliver genuine cryptanalytic progress under human guidance, opening defensive uses while highlighting longer-term risks of automated discovery outpacing defenses.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿模型在人類指導下可貢獻真實密碼分析進展，帶來防禦機會，同時凸顯自動化發現可能超越防禦的長期風險。
items_flat.quote: Using Claude Mythos Preview, researchers at Anthropic have discovered improved ways to attack cryptographic algorithms... The first attack significantly weakens HAWK... The second identifies a new way to attack round-reduced AES.
items_flat.quote_zh: 使用 Claude Mythos Preview，Anthropic 研究人員發現了攻擊密碼演算法的改進方法……第一次攻擊大幅削弱 HAWK……第二次找到攻擊簡化輪數 AES 的新方法。

items_flat.title_en: 1,100+ AI Lab Staff Petition US to Support Tools for Pacing Frontier Development
items_flat.title_zh: 逾1,100名 AI 實驗室員工聯署籲美國支持 pacing 前沿發展工具
items_flat.summary_en: More than 1,100 current and former employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and others signed the “Pacing the Frontier” statement asking the US government to support international technical and governance tools that could deliberately pace automated AI research. It is not a call for a moratorium.
items_flat.summary_zh: 逾1,100名來自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta 等現任與前任員工簽署「Pacing the Frontier」聲明，要求美國政府支持可刻意調節自動化 AI 研究前沿的國際技術與治理工具。並非要求暫停發展。
items_flat.analysis_en: The cross-lab staff consensus signals growing internal concern about recursive self-improvement risks while stopping short of a pause. Whether governments can build usable pacing mechanisms remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室員工共識顯示對遞迴自我改進風險的內部關切加劇，但未主張暫停。政府能否建立可用的 pacing 機制仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 支持國際努力，開發可刻意調節自動化 AI 發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Academic Researchers with Free Frontier Access for up to 100,000
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers，最高提供 10 萬名研究者免費前沿模型存取
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced ChatGPT for Academic Researchers, giving eligible faculty and postdocs free 12-month access to frontier models including the GPT-5.6 family, starting with 10,000 researchers this summer and expanding to 100,000 through 2027. Workspaces include business-grade privacy (data not used for training by default), expanded deep research, life-science skills, and up to four collaborators.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布啟動 ChatGPT for Academic Researchers 計畫，從今年暑假起先開放 1 萬名合格學術研究者免費使用 GPT-5.6 等前沿模型與工具，並計畫擴至 10 萬名至 2027 年。工作區具備商業級隱私保護，研究資料預設不訓練模型，並包含生命科學技能與支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands frontier AI access beyond well-resourced labs and may accelerate discovery, yet eligibility gates, long-term funding sustainability, and actual scientific impact remain to be measured.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉擴大前沿 AI 對學術社群的可及性，可能加速科學發現，但實際申請門檻與長期資源分配仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: We believe the benefits of frontier AI should not be concentrated in a few companies and well-resourced labs. Researchers know their fields best.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們相信前沿 AI 的好處不應集中在少數公司與資源豐富的實驗室。研究人員最了解自己的領域。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with Improved Intelligence, Transcription and Agentic Performance
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 新一代語音模型
items_flat.summary_en: xAI (via SpaceXAI) announced Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, its next-generation voice model with gains in speech reasoning, conversational dynamics, and agentic tool use. It shows 1.5–2× better transcription accuracy versus prior SOTA and its predecessor, 0.70 s time-to-first-audio, and leads the Artificial Analysis τ-voice agentic bench. Available now in the API and Voice Agent Builder at $0.08 per minute of audio; the latest alias migrates on 5 August.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI（SpaceXAI）宣布 Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，提升智能、轉錄準確度（較前代 1.4×，嘈雜環境大幅改善）與對話能力。API 與 Voice Agent Builder 今日可用，定價每分鐘音訊 0.08 美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: Stronger full-duplex and agentic voice scores strengthen real-time use cases, especially noisy or tool-calling scenarios; sustained leadership versus peers will need ongoing independent benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音 agent 性能提升強化實時應用場景，特別是嘈雜與工具呼叫情境，但與競爭對手的持續領先仍需基準測試追蹤。
items_flat.quote: Announcing Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, our next-generation voice model with improved intelligence, transcription accuracy, and conversational capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 宣布 Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0，我們的下一代語音模型，具備改進的智能、轉錄準確度與對話能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Quietly Releases Open-Source Codex Security CLI
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 低調發布開源 Codex Security CLI
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an early open-source release of the Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK. Developers can now scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD pipelines via npm or GitHub.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布早期開源發布 Codex Security CLI 與 TypeScript SDK。開發者現可掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並透過 npm 或 GitHub 將安全檢查加入 CI/CD 流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: This makes agentic security scanning more accessible outside ChatGPT Enterprise tiers and could accelerate “security-left” practices in AI-assisted coding. Real-world false-positive rates and coverage remain to be proven at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓 agentic 安全掃描更易於在 ChatGPT Enterprise 之外使用，可能加速 AI 輔助編碼的「安全左移」實踐。真實世界誤報率與覆蓋範圍仍待大規模驗證。
items_flat.quote: We quietly released the open-source Codex Security CLI... You can now use it to scan repositories, track findings across runs, verify fixes, and add security checks to CI/CD.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們低調發布了開源 Codex Security CLI……現在可用它掃描程式庫、跨執行追蹤發現、驗證修復，並將安全檢查加入 CI/CD。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Details GPT-5.6 Sol Self-Optimizations: 20% Lower Serving Costs, 15%+ Token Efficiency
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 展示 GPT-5.6 Sol 自我優化，推理成本降 20%、生成效率提升逾 15%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it applied GPT-5.6 Sol after deployment to improve its own serving stack, achieving 20% lower serving costs via GPU kernel improvements (rewritten in Triton/Gluon) and more than 15% better token-generation efficiency from enhanced speculative decoding, plus agentic-harness refinements.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示部署後運用 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Codex 優化自身服務堆疊，透過 GPU kernel 改進降低 20% 服務成本，並以改進 speculative decoding 提升逾 15% token 生成效率。
items_flat.analysis_en: Using a frontier model to optimize its own inference stack illustrates practical agentic gains at the infrastructure layer and could reshape cost curves, though independent replication and broader applicability are still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 模型協助優化自身運行效率，凸顯 agentic 能力在基礎設施層的潛力，長期可能改變成本曲線，但獨立驗證與廣泛適用性仍待確認。
items_flat.quote: After deployment, we applied GPT-5.6 Sol to advance the frontier of efficiency by making itself more efficient to run. The results: 20% lower serving costs... 15%+ better token-generation efficiency.
items_flat.quote_zh: 部署後，我們運用 GPT-5.6 Sol 推進效率前沿，讓自身運行更有效率。結果：服務成本降低 20%……token 生成效率提升逾 15%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Field Report: Agentic AI in Scientific Computing
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 實地報告：Agentic AI 在科學計算中的應用
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an exploratory field report of eight case studies (mostly life sciences) showing how Codex and Claude Code agents helped modernize scientific software—from maintenance and optimization to large-scale migrations and redesigns.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布探索性實地報告，涵蓋八個案例（多為生命科學），展示 Codex 與 Claude Code agents 如何協助現代化科學軟體——從維護優化到大規模遷移與重新設計。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report usefully documents real velocity gains but correctly cautions that agents do not remove the need for scientific judgment or sustainable ownership models. Broader adoption will hinge on reproducibility and maintainer collaboration.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告有用記錄了實際速度提升，但正確提醒 agents 無法取代科學判斷或可持續的擁有模式。更廣泛採用將取決於可重現性與維護者合作。
items_flat.quote: Across eight case studies spanning industry and academia, we explore what this shift means for scientific computing—and why human verification, stewardship, and long-term maintenance matter.
items_flat.quote_zh: 透過涵蓋產業與學術的八個案例，我們探討這項轉變對科學計算的意義——以及為何人類驗證、管理與長期維護至關重要。

items_flat.title_en: Google Releases Lyria 3.5 Music Model with Better Vocals, Lyrics and Creative Control
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布 Lyria 3.5 音樂模型，提升人聲、歌詞與創作控制
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Lyria 3.5, its latest music-generation model now powering Google Flow Music. The update improves musicality, lyrics, vocals, tempo and duration control for more expressive and steerable generation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 宣布 Lyria 3.5，最新音樂生成模型，已在 Google Flow Music 推出。更新改進音樂性、歌詞、人聲、節奏與時長控制，使生成更富表達力且可操控。
items_flat.analysis_en: Incremental but practical advances in controllable music generation strengthen Google’s creative-media stack; competitive differentiation versus other audio models will depend on real-user quality and latency.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可控音樂生成的實用改進強化 Google 創作媒體堆疊；與其他音訊模型的差異化將取決於真實用戶品質與延遲。
items_flat.quote: Meet Lyria 3.5, the newest music model from Google DeepMind, now powering Flow Music.
items_flat.quote_zh: 認識 Lyria 3.5，Google DeepMind 最新音樂模型，現已驅動 Flow Music。

frontier_other.analysis_en: The cross-lab staff consensus signals growing internal concern about recursive self-improvement risks while stopping short of a pause. Whether governments can build usable pacing mechanisms remains uncertain.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 跨實驗室員工共識顯示對遞迴自我改進風險的內部關切加劇，但未主張暫停。政府能否建立可用的 pacing 機制仍不確定。
frontier_other.quote: support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 支持國際努力，開發可刻意調節自動化 AI 發展前沿所需的技術與治理工具。

brief_en: OpenAI launched free frontier-model access for up to 100k academic researchers and detailed GPT-5.6 self-optimizations cutting serving costs 20%. xAI shipped Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 with strong transcription and agentic gains. Google released Lyria 3.5 music model. Earlier: Anthropic Mythos crypto advances, cross-lab pacing petition, OpenAI Codex Security CLI and scientific-agent field report.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出最高10萬名學術研究者免費前沿模型存取，並展示GPT-5.6自我優化降成本20%。xAI發布Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0語音模型。Google推出Lyria 3.5音樂模型。另有Anthropic Mythos密碼學發現、跨lab pacing聯署、OpenAI Codex Security CLI與科學agent報告。
